review.notes: All 43 physical pages diffed line-by-line against the OCR markdown (normalized, punctuation/case-insensitive, LaTeX-equivalent math accepted); flagged lines triaged against rendered pages. Chart-axis/bar labels on pages 12, 16, 19, 21, 24, 25, 27, 29, 30, 32, 39 are inside embedded figure images and correctly absent from the text. The brownie/Wixel transcripts on pages 7-8 are printed transcript boxes reproduced as HTML tables/image embeds and are not droppage. Footnote bodies 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 were dropped by OCR while all markers survive; each body was restored after the paragraph carrying its marker and verified at 300 dpi. Footnote 2's body word-for-word duplicates the em-dash continuation already in the sentence ('scheming which tends to be legible in the model outputs'), so it was not re-inserted. Reference [14] had a flattened L-stroke on two LUKASZ-name occurrences (printed L-with-stroke, verified at 300 dpi), one doubled letter, and a run of ~65 author names glued without spaces from 'H.P.de Oliveira Pinto' through 'J.Weng'; the print itself reads 'Michael, Pokorny,' (comma between the names) and that print spelling is preserved. '## Assistant:' speaker labels from the appendix transcript boxes were demoted from headings to plain text. Reference title 'Gpt-4 technical report' matches the print and was left unchanged.
